ValidationRule.description: This validation would trigger when card nature picklist value and cancellation reason picklist does not match.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND($User.LastName <> "Integration", ISPICKVAL(Type,'Credit Card Account Closing'), ISPICKVAL(Sub_Type__c,'Credit Card Account Closing'), OR( AND( ISPICKVAL(Card_Nature__c,'secured'), ISPICKVAL(Closure_Reason__c, 'Want to apply for a loan/finance'), NOT(ISPICKVAL(Closure_Reason__c, '')) ), AND( ISPICKVAL(Card_Nature__c,'unsecured'), ISPICKVAL(Closure_Reason__c, 'Need liquidity'), NOT(ISPICKVAL(Closure_Reason__c, '')) ) ))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: The credit card cancellation reason you have selected is not valid for this credit card type. Kindly select another reason from the list.
